businesses.business: mobile advertising and app distribution platform

offering_description.value: Provides a mobile growth platform that lets advertisers acquire users and lets mobile carriers and device makers monetize devices. It delivers app preloads, on-device app discovery and in-app advertising through software installed on handsets and a programmatic ad exchange.

primary_products.value: on-device app delivery software; mobile advertising platform; programmatic ad exchange; supply-side ad technology

primary_services.value: app install advertising; user acquisition campaigns; app publisher monetization

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers, app developers, mobile carriers, device manufacturers, app publishers

end_markets.value: mobile advertising; mobile apps; telecommunications; consumer electronics; gaming

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: advertiser payments per app install or ad impression, sharing revenue with carriers and publishers; service fees: platform and campaign management fees from advertisers and publishers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: ad-tech and device software platform connecting advertisers with carrier devices and app publishers; service provider: user acquisition and monetization services for app developers and carriers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: on-device media and app distribution plus app-based programmatic advertising exchange

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to advertisers, carriers, OEMs and app publishers; partners / resellers: embedded through carrier and device maker partnerships and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and advertising rules such as GDPR, CCPA and platform policies
